question: Ivermectin is indicated in all of the following except:
analysis: Ivermectin is an antiparasitic medication primarily used to treat infections caused by certain parasites. It is effective against Ascaris (roundworm), Filariasis (caused by Wuchereria bancrofti and other filarial worms), and Onchocerciasis (river blindness caused by Onchocerca volvulus). However, Ivermectin is not indicated for the treatment of Malaria, which is caused by Plasmodium parasites and typically treated with antimalarial drugs such as chloroquine, artemisinin-based combination therapies, or others.
